Maya (Sec): Security advisory: we found stale GitHub App installation tokens in third-party integration logs. Rotate all installation tokens by 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Org scan 2026-03-22 -> 14 integrations with app tokens older than 90 days. Report: https://go/internal/integration-token-rotations

Noah (Platform): Which integrations are affected? Can we get a per-repo mapping?

Maya (Sec): Uploaded CSV to the report link and emailed owners. Short checklist: revoke old installation tokens in GitHub App console, create new installation access token, update secret in repo/CI, validate deploys.

Rita (SRE): If rotation breaks deploys, what's the emergency flow?

Maya (Sec): Open infra-support ticket and request a temporary token (max 24h). Exceptions need infra-oncall + sec lead sign-off. We'll keep a short exception window to limit blast radius.

Jin (Devex): Is there an automated helper? Doing this by hand for 14 integrations is tedious.

Maya (Sec): Use tools/rotate_github_app.py --org redwood --dry-run to preview changes; it can open PRs or update secrets when run without --dry-run. Review required. Docs: https://go/internal/rotate-github-app

Noah (Platform): Running dry-run now, will post the PR list here.

deploy-bot: Reminder: daily digest until 2026-04-02.

Maya (Sec): Thanks team. Please reply here when your services have been rotated and validated. :lock:
